purpose: R2 selected-method execution contract; not a completed experiment

source.scope: Sections 4.3 and 5.2.2 auxiliary RNN method; not all methods in the paper

implementation: JAX reimplementation of selected TM02 v1 RNN method

reference_material.constitutive_interpretation: Eq.29 is implemented as V=[(1-o)*exp(-(norm_F(sigma_ov)/a)^b)+o]*V0: dimensionless o multiplies the full fourth-order V0 tensor. Table 1 eta_K=400 and eta_D=200 are interpreted in MPa*s, because Eq.27 differentiated with respect to strain rate must yield MPa. The printed tensor-plus-scalar and MPa/s are ambiguous; this is the project's dimensional interpretation, not verified author code.

data.bound_rule: resample increment when the proposed knot exceeds the paper's bound
data.project_choices: Seeds, natural spline boundary condition and same underlying path for ideal/noisy are fixed project choices, not recovered author data.

dissipation.convex_activation_provenance: project choice permitted by Appendix A.2; Table 4 leaves this entry unspecified

model.corrections: Preserve free-energy zero-state and dissipation zero-rate corrections as defined in the paper.
model.normalization: Appendix A.3, training data only; internal-variable scales estimated from strain and strain rate, not reference internal variables.

loss.note: Implement the RNN equations directly; do not substitute the FNN loss normalization.

training.budget_provenance: 25 initializations and final-training-loss selection follow Section 5.2.2. 20,000 iterations are the fixed project budget; the learning-rate schedule is borrowed from the explicitly stated Section 5.2.1 schedule.

numerics.integration: implicit Euler, Newton-Raphson with residual-merit backtracking; no time subdivision or alternate solver
numerics.shear_convention: tensor components; tensor gradients divide shear derivatives by 2

implementation_choices.positive_weights: softplus of unconstrained parameters; initialized with abs(Glorot uniform)+0.01 then inverse softplus
implementation_choices.other_weights: NumPy default_rng(seed) Glorot uniform; biases zero; same initialization for paired ideal/noisy runs
implementation_choices.output_activations: linear FICNN and PICNN output; softplus hidden convex layers, tanh hidden nonconvex layer
implementation_choices.normalization: A.3 midpoint/half-range for each invariant from training strain and finite-difference strain rate; scalar component-wide strain/stress ranges for RNN; q,p estimated from strain only; potential scale s_e*s_sigma, dissipation scale s_edot*s_sigma (MPa/s). Potential offsets cancel in zero-state corrections.
implementation_choices.initial_state: q0=0; LSTM h0=c0=0; first RNN input is t1; no auxiliary pretraining
implementation_choices.loss_components: equal mean over 200 increments and six independent physical tensor components
implementation_choices.path_rng_order: sample clock then spline knots; reject only offending component increments
